title: File a hospital insurance claim with a browser agent
summary: A poster pointed Gemini 4 Argon in Antigravity at their insurance portal; they say it merged scans into a 17-page PDF, pulled bill details and filed the claim.
agent_role: The agent opened the portal, downloaded the form and checklist, merged scans, extracted bill details and uploaded the claim; the human supplied the scans and started the task.
outcome: Poster reports the agent filed the entire claim by itself.
what_they_did: The poster used the browser mode in Google's Antigravity tool with Gemini 4 Argon. They pointed it at their health insurance website. It downloaded the claim form and checklist, merged their raw scans into one 17-page PDF, and pulled out bill numbers, dates, lab and heart test charges and totals.
how_it_went: The poster says the agent uploaded and filed the whole claim for them.
worth_knowing: The post does not say whether the poster reviewed the extracted figures before submitting; check amounts and documents before letting an agent file.
prompt: Open my insurance portal at [portal URL] and find the hospital claim form and document checklist. Download both. Merge my scanned bills and reports in [folder] into one PDF in the checklist order. Extract every bill number, date, charge type and total into a table. Fill in the claim form. Show me the table, the filled form and the PDF, and wait for my approval before uploading or submitting anything.

curation.rationale: A concrete first-hand account of a browser agent handling a full hospital insurance claim, a useful non-coding task; lightly evidenced with no screenshots or result beyond filing.
